    page_ids = []
    content_ids = []
    next_id = 3
    for _ in pages:
        page_ids.append(next_id)
        next_id += 1
        content_ids.append(next_id)
        next_id += 1
    kids = ' '.join(f'{pid} 0 R' for pid in page_ids)
    objects.insert(1, f'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [{kids}] /Count {len(pages)} >>'.encode())

        out += f'{i} 0 obj\n'.encode()
        out += obj
        out += b'\nendobj\n'

            {'kind': 'line', 'x1': title_x, 'y1': title_y - 14,
             'x2': title_x + title_w, 'y2': title_y - 14},
            {'kind': 'text', 'text': date_text, 'x': date_x, 'y': date_y,

        'Operating expenses remained in line with the approved budget.',

        else:
            content = [{'kind': 'text', 'text': line, 'x': 72, 'y': y,
                        'size': 12, 'font': 'F1'}]
        body_pages.append({'content': content})
        y -= 40
    build_pdf('report_body.pdf', body_pages)

    writer = PdfWriter()
    for src in ['cover.pdf', 'report_body.pdf']:
        reader = PdfReader(src)
        for page in reader.pages:
            writer.add_page(page)
    with open('report.pdf', 'wb') as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print('Merged cover.pdf + report_body.pdf -> report.pdf')

    check = PdfReader('report.pdf')
    print(f'report.pdf pages: {len(check.pages)}')
    for i, page in enumerate(check.pages):
        txt = page.extract_text() or ''
        print(f'  Page {i+1}: {txt.strip()!r}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
